articles.title: First Bankers Trustshares Inc's Dividend Analysis
articles.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. First Bankers Trustshares Inc (FBTT) recently announced a total dividend of $0.23 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-25. This amount consists entirely of a $0.23 per share cash dividend, which is payable to shareholders on 2026-10-30.
